name: NFL Elo
metric: increase in holdout log loss when the component is neutralised

features.name: Margin of victory
features.detail: every win counts the same, whatever the margin

features.name: Postseason K weight
features.detail: playoff games update like any other

caveat: Neutralising a component changes every rating after it, so these are contributions to the whole replay, not to one game. 'Margin of victory' clamps the margin to a point rather than removing the multiplier, which also shrinks the update size — read it as 'margin ignored', not as a clean K-preserving swap.
